issues.legal_issue: A judgment on admission under Order XII Rule 6 of the Code of Civil Procedure requires a clear, unambiguous, unequivocal, and unconditional admission, and an unclear statement involving a mixed question of fact and law cannot justify such a judgment.
Heirs who ordinarily resided with a tenant inherited the tenancy jointly with the surviving spouse under the West Bengal Premises Tenancy Act, 1956.

The five-year limitation in Section 2(g) of the West Bengal Premises Tenancy Act, 1997 does not retrospectively extinguish tenancy rights that heirs had inherited under the 1956 Act before the 1997 Act came into force, absent a clear legislative intention to that effect.
